colors.description: Editorial Clinical Archetype. A calming Warm Bone/Sand (#F4F4F0) background with deep, sophisticated Slate Blue/Navy text for a non-sterile, luxury clinical feel. No purple/violet gradients.

typography.description: Cormorant Garamond for elegant, calm authority in headings. Manrope for crisp, highly readable clinical body text.
rules: Headings use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines use uppercase and wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Heading maximum size is text-6xl. Do not use text-8xl+ for main headings.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows for cards. No harsh box-shadows. Prefer border-only separation in some cases.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 or #CBD5E1 for crisp definition on forms and UI elements.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm to maintain an editorial, serious, specialist edge.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to break digital flatness.

layouts.hero: Kinetic hero with large typography. Asymmetrical image placement with subtle parallax.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01-06) for the 6-step treatment philosophy. Use vertical scrolling with sticky layout or bold typography reveals.
layouts.clinical_categories: Bento grid (Mode A: Tetris Grid) or large full-width rows with hover reveals (01-04).
layouts.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-24 padding. Never center-everything. Emphasize asymmetry and negative space.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using framer-motion (overflow-hidden wrapper around each line, animate y from 100% to 0).
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer-motion fade up and slight translateY for sections as they enter viewport.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for the Trust Stack (MDS qualification, TRIOS 3 digital workflow, process, continuity). Use react-fast-marquee.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image and clinical macro shots.

components.patient_intake_form: Shadcn UI Form, Input, Textarea. Clean, editorial styling. Fields: Name, age, location, chief complaint, 'What would you most like to be able to do again?'.
components.ai_chat: Fixed bottom-right chat widget, styled cleanly in brand colors. Mock the conversation logic.
components.whatsapp_cta: Prominent CTA for WhatsApp (+91 9043432286). Could be floating or prominently placed in nav/hero.
components.general_rules: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Use Shadcn ONLY for interactive elements (Forms, Accordion). Do not use Shadcn 'Card' for creative sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Dark slate text on warm sand meets this easily.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='request-consultation-btn').

hero_portrait.description: South Asian male doctor portrait for the hero section.

macro_implant.description: Detailed macro shot of a dental implant for clinical categories or philosophy.

clinic_interior.description: Premium dental clinic interior for the facility note section.

libraries.lucide_react: Already installed, use for minimal icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the masked line-by-line text reveal in the hero using framer-motion.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Do not trap yourself in rigid Shadcn components for structural sections.
No centered uniform card grids. Use asymmetrical layouts and large typography.
Implement the 6-step treatment philosophy with large numbers (01, 02, etc.) in Cormorant Garamond.
Integrate an AI chat widget component (mocked logic or simple UI for now, but fully styled).
Ensure the Patient Intake Form has the specific fields requested.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers over content. Use backdrop-blur and a semi-solid background.
Do not add .App { text-align: center; } in CSS.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI outputs. Avoid purple/violet gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully if needed, but prefer solid editorial surfaces for this medical site.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
